_readme: Published figures for the March 2025 fire that motivates this project, compiled 2026-09-04 under CHARTER section 3 rule 5b. Two scopes are kept apart on purpose: 'chain' = the 의성발 경북 산불 (의성→안동→청송→영양→영덕, ignited 2025-03-22 11:24, 주불 진화 2025-03-28 17:15); 'nationwide' = every fire of the 2025 spring season (347 fires, 2025-01-24 to 2025-05-15). A figure whose status is 'interim' is a pre-containment tally kept only so a gate can refuse it as a final value. Each figure carries agency, as_of date, scope, status and the URL that was opened to verify it; 'verified' records what the page actually said. Registered in docs/NUMBERS.json under the fire2025_ prefix and enforced against README.md by scripts/check_readme_figures.py.

chain_area_ha.verified: page opened 2026-09-04: '피해 면적 9만 9,289ha, 주불 진화 시간 총 149시간이 소요되어 2,246세대, 3,587명의 이재민을 발생시켰다'; largest since statistics began in 1986

chain_deaths.verified: 뉴시스 2025-03-29 09:39: '경북 산불, 영양·의성서 사망자 2명 추가…총 26명 숨져'; 서울신문 2025-03-30 (중대본 주불 진화 브리핑): 사망 30명 = 경북 26 + 경남 4. The nationwide 32 (산림청, 2025-05-16) counts the whole spring season.

chain_deaths_yeongdeok.agency: 영덕군 공지 2025-04-29 (재인용: 2026-03 「2025 영남 초대형 산불 피해 실태조사 최종보고서」 p.9; 재인용값이며 조사 결과가 아님)
chain_deaths_yeongdeok.verified: repository evidence note under docs/evidence/ (survey evidence, section 7 item 1, extracted by scripts/extract_survey_evidence.py); corrected from 8 at f2eecf9. The 중대본 breakdown of 2025-03-30 gave 영덕 9 at that date; 10 is the later county figure. The survey's own measurements are deliberately NOT registered (the survey-leak test under tests/ pins that); this key is the county's count, re-cited.

nationwide_fires.verified: page opened 2026-09-04: '올해 산불 발생 건수는 최근 10년 평균(394건)보다 12% 감소한 347건'; period 2025-01-24 to 2025-05-15

nationwide_area_ha.verified: same page: '피해 면적은 104,788헥타르(ha)로 1986년 산불통계 작성 이래 가장 피해가 컸으며'

yeongnam_homes_damaged.scope: yeongnam complex (경북+경남+울산), NOT nationwide and NOT the chain alone
yeongnam_homes_damaged.agency: 공동 실태조사 최종보고서(2026-03) summary citing 산림청 (attribution not confirmed in the 산림청 2025-05-16 release, which carries no 주택 figure)
yeongnam_homes_damaged.verified: 2026-09-04: the 산림청 2025-05-16 press release (korea.kr 156689401) states 347 / 104,788 ha / 32 / 54 and NO housing figure; 3,848동 appears in the joint report's description of the 영남 초대형 산불. Registered so the number cannot be re-described as a 산림청 nationwide figure; docs/data_sources.md table B is annotated accordingly.

interim_chain_area_ha_20250327.verified: 경향신문 2025-03-28 reporting the 중대본 2025-03-27 tally; one day before 주불 진화. NEVER a final value: commit 12b8ac7 wrote it as final and was wrong by 54,132 ha (critic #4, F16).

interim_homes_destroyed_20250326.verified: secondary (Korean Wikipedia, citing the 산림청 2025-03-26 briefing): '주택 150채 … 275개소가 전소'. Two days before containment; the final figure is 3,819동.

retired_values_with_no_scope.27_deaths: neither the chain (26) nor nationwide (32). Original README value, withdrawn.
